SYSTEM PHILOSOPHY & ARCHITECTURE

The Engineering Behind Taskee

Modern desktop utilities frequently ship bundled with an entire Chromium browser and Node.js runtime, consuming hundreds of megabytes of RAM just to monitor RAM. Taskee was built to restore sanity: 100% native Rust, sub-millisecond execution, and brutalist high-density telemetry.

CORE TENETS

Three Foundational Principles

01

Zero Webview, Zero Runtime

Taskee contains zero JavaScript, zero Node.js, and zero HTML renderer in the desktop app. It compiles directly to native x86_64 machine code, starting up in under 150 milliseconds.

Pure Rust <15 MB RAM
02

Immediate-Mode Rendering

Built using eframe and egui. Unlike retained-mode frameworks that construct heavy DOM node trees, Taskee's interface is freshly rendered on the GPU each frame with zero GC pauses.

egui 0.36 Zero Memory Leaks
03

Brutalist ArtCraft HUD

Hardware telemetry should be legible, dense, and uncompromising. Taskee uses razor-thin borders, monospace alignment, and an ultra-dark palette engineered for developer workstations.

Monospace HUD OLED Pitch Black
DATA PIPELINE

Sub-Millisecond Telemetry Pipeline

How hardware signals transition from OS kernel APIs to immediate-mode GPU drawing in 1-second calibrated loops.

STAGE 01
Kernel Instrumentation
Queries Windows NtQuerySystemInformation or Linux /proc via sysinfo 0.39.
STAGE 02
Delta Calibration
monitor.rs primes measurement windows to eliminate the 0% initial CPU delta flaw.
STAGE 03
Ring Buffer Aggregator
Maintains rolling 60-second time-series vectors for CPU load, RAM saturation, and throughput.
STAGE 04
GPU Immediate Rendering
eframe paints HUD telemetry, time-series curves, and process tables at 60 FPS.
CRATE STRUCTURE

Source Architecture Breakdown

Clean, modular design adhering to strict idiomatic Rust practices.

TASKEE SOURCE TREE (CARGO WORKSPACE) RUST EDITION 2024 
taskee/
├── Cargo.toml               # Workspace manifest
├── README.md                # Technical documentation
├── assets/
│   └── logo.jpg             # Cyber HUD brand identity
└── src/
    ├── main.rs              # Native runtime setup & ArtCraft styling
    ├── app.rs               # HUD navigation tabs & 1-second update loop
    ├── monitor.rs           # Calibrated sysinfo telemetry engine
    └── ui/
        ├── mod.rs           # UI module definitions
        ├── theme.rs         # ArtCraft ultra-dark color tokens
        ├── overview.rs      # Workstation specs & 4-card HUD
        ├── performance.rs   # Live egui_plot charts & per-core grid
        ├── processes.rs     # Interactive process table & SIGKILL
        └── storage_net.rs   # Disk partitions & network throughput

monitor.rs — Telemetry Core

Handles multi-threaded hardware polling. Reads CPU frequencies, individual logical core percentages, total/available physical memory, swap space, disk mount points, and network packet rates.

performance.rs — Time Plots

Leverages egui_plot to draw rolling 60-second curves. Features dynamic bounds, dual plot legends, and the 16-thread visual utilization matrix with auto-scaling.

processes.rs — Process Dispatcher

Implements workstation process table sorting by CPU, Memory, PID, Name, or Runtime. Includes instant keyword substring search and safe process termination signals.
